```text
# #2579: Patch: retire `cargo jackioh luau surface`, the survey for moving official cards to Luau
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

Blocked by #2497 (its part 14, #2515, compacts the comments of `crates/tools`, Luau included; deleting these files first would conflict with its reconcile).

## Why
`cargo jackioh luau surface` (`crates/tools/src/luau/surface.rs`, 1,819 lines) was groundwork for #442: it lists, card by card, the engine API each Rust card script calls, so the scripts could be moved to Luau (#560, part 6). #902 (v0.5.0) brought every official card back to Rust, and #2156 removed `docs/v0.4.0/PORTING.md`. Nothing runs the command any more: no workflow, script or test outside its own, and `docs/v0.4.0/api-gaps.md` says it "was not re-run" for its last update. Luau itself stays: custom cards run on it (`docs/custom-cards.md`), so `crates/luau`, `luau diff` and `luau bench` are untouched.

The owner approved removing the subcommand here (CLAUDE.md rule 13).

## Do
- Delete `crates/tools/src/luau/surface.rs` and the text fixtures only it reads, `crates/tools/tests/luau/*.rs` (`calls`, `clone`, `edit`, `field`, `helpers`, `literals`, `spread`, `unreadable`). Before deleting, confirm with `git grep` that nothing else reads them. Keep `crates/tools/tests/luau.rs`, which tests `golden record` and `luau diff`.
- `crates/tools/src/luau.rs`: drop `mod surface`, the `Surface` variant and its arm, and the header and doc lines that name it. `crates/tools/src/main.rs:80`: the doc line names only `luau diff` and `luau bench`.
- `crates/tools/README.md`: delete the `luau surface` row.
- `crates/luau/README.md` and `crates/luau/src/reads.rs`: drop or reword the lines that cite `luau surface`, in comments only.
- `docs/v0.4.0/api-gaps.md`: keep it as the record of the Luau API's gaps. Replace its "regenerate with `cargo jackioh luau surface --json`" instructions (around lines 5–20) with one line saying the command was retired by this issue; its numbers are part 6's. `docs/v0.4.0/README.md`: the groundwork row (around line 91) says the same.
- Nothing else. No change to `.github/`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cargo jackioh luau surface` is an unknown subcommand. `cargo jackioh luau diff --help` and `luau bench --help` still work.
- [ ] `git grep -n "luau surface\|luau::surface\|SurfaceArgs"` prints only `docs/v0.4.0/` lines that describe its retirement.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` labels it `kind:internal` with no pending fragment.
```
